They were coached by [[Mike Anderson (basketball, born 1959)|Mike Anderson]], in his third year at the school, and played their home games at [[Carnesecca Arena]] and [[Madison Square Garden]] as members of the [[Big East Conference]]. ==Previous season== The [[2020–21 St. John's Red Storm men's basketball team|Red Storm]] finished the season 16–11, 10–9 in [[2020–21 Big East Conference men's basketball season|Big East play]] to finish in a tie for fourth place.
